name: CYPARK
recent: Cypark 完成了凭单红股发行，并上市了 452,555,088 张凭单（Warrants A），行使价为 RM0.8000。公司还完成了第三批也是最后一批私募配售，配售 7,682,700 股新股。最新季度（截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日）恢复盈利，营收环比和同比均大幅增长。
notable: 完成了凭单红股发行，并上市了 452,555,088 张凭单（Warrants A），行使价为 RM0.8000。
完成了第三批也是最后一批私募配售，配售 7,682,700 股新股。
最新季度（截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日）恢复盈利，净利润为 RM5.696 百万。
risks: 大股东 Dato' Daud bin Ahmad 在公开市场出售了 2.36 百万股，持股比例降至 5.382%。
公司进行了私募配售，可能对现有股东造成股权摊薄。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日的季度，营收为 RM180.048 百万，环比增长 274.2%，同比增长 332.2%；净利润为 RM5.696 百万，净利润率为 3.2%，而上一季度净利润率为 -35.0%。

recent_en: Cypark completed its bonus issue of warrants with the listing of 452,555,088 Warrants A at an exercise price of RM0.8000. The company also completed the third and final tranche of its private placement with 7,682,700 new shares. The latest quarter (ended 31 July 2026) returned to profitability with strong revenue growth both QoQ and YoY.
notable_en: Completed the bonus issue of warrants with the listing of 452,555,088 Warrants A at an exercise price of RM0.8000.
Completed the third and final tranche of the private placement with 7,682,700 new shares.
Returned to profitability in the latest quarter (ended 31 July 2026) with a net profit of RM5.696 million.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder Dato' Daud bin Ahmad sold 2.36 million shares in the open market, reducing his stake to 5.382%.
The company undertook a private placement, which may dilute existing shareholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM180.048 million, up 274.2% QoQ and 332.2% YoY; net profit was RM5.696 million with a net margin of 3.2%, compared to a net margin of -35.0% in the previous quarter.
